$comment: Local Lighthouse CI config. Run with: pnpm run lighthouse (after `pnpm dlx @lhci/cli@0.14.x install` or installing globally). Builds + starts the production server, audits the 5 highest-traffic routes, asserts thresholds. Adjust thresholds upward as the codebase improves — we set the floor at acceptable, not aspirational.

collect.startServerCommand: pnpm run build && pnpm run start
